config.heading: Settings: {name}

placeholders.mapAddress: e.g. 123 ABC Street, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City
placeholders.menuNote: e.g. Book a table at the front desk or call 0912…

cover.label: Cover photo
cover.hint: The first photo of the strip at the top of the page: pick one of the property's photos, or upload a new one (landscape looks best).
cover.none: The property has no photos yet. Add some under Overview → Photos.

reviews.label: Guest reviews
reviews.hint: Only add real reviews from your guests (copied from Google, Booking.com, your guest book…). With no reviews the block doesn't show on the website.
reviews.name: Guest name
reviews.textPlaceholder: What the guest wrote about the hotel

config.servicesHint: This block shows the services that are on in the Services page. Add or edit them there.
config.menuHint: This block shows the dishes on sale in the Menu page, by group. With no dishes it doesn't show on the website.
config.footerHint: This block shows the name, address, phone and email from the property's Overview page.

preview.roomsTitle: Choose a room for your trip
preview.roomsCount: {count, plural, one {# room type} other {# room types}} at {name}.
preview.roomsEmpty: No rooms are listed yet. Please contact {name} directly.
preview.moreAmenities: {count, plural, one {+# more amenity} other {+# more amenities}}
preview.amenitiesEmpty: The list of amenities is being updated.

reviews.none: No reviews yet: this block is hidden on the website. Open its settings to add your guests' real reviews.

preview.contactIntro: Reach the hotel directly through any of these.
preview.moreDishes: {count, plural, one {And # more dish} other {And # more dishes}}

hidden.about: The About block isn't shown on the website: it has no text yet. Write it in the block's settings, or describe the property on the Overview page.
hidden.gallery: The Gallery block isn't shown on the website: the property has no photos yet (Overview → Photos).
hidden.services: The Services block isn't shown on the website: no service is on yet (Services page).
hidden.menu: The Menu block isn't shown on the website: no dish is on sale yet (Menu page).

blocks.arrangeHint: Drag and drop to change the order
blocks.emptyHint: Pick a template or add blocks yourself
blocks.addHint: Pick a block to add to your website
blocks.defaultLayout: The website shows the default layout below. Edit or reorder it, then press Save changes to make it your own.

style.primaryHint: Links, prices, review stars and highlights.
style.buttonHint: “Book now”, “Search”… buttons, outlined buttons and the booking banner.
style.heading: Heading color
style.contrastNote: A color too light or too dark for the background is adjusted a little so text always reads, in the light and dark themes.

settings.metaDescriptionPlaceholder: A short description of your property...

publish.title: Publishing
publish.publishedHint: Guests can see the website and book on it.
publish.unpublishedHint: Only signed-in members can see it (as a preview); guests can't book yet.

canvas.dragging: Dragging... Drop the block where you want it
canvas.emptyHint: Add blocks from the panel on the left or pick a template. Saved with no blocks, the website uses the default layout.

domain.title: Custom domain
domain.intro: Use the hotel's own domain (e.g. www.khachsan.vn) for the website. Type it and press Check: you'll see the DNS records to add where you manage the domain.
domain.label: Domain
domain.checkFailed: Couldn't check the domain, please try again
domain.recordsTitle: Add these records where your domain's DNS is managed, then press Check again
domain.name: Name
domain.noAddress: Couldn't get Digistay's IP address, please try again in a few minutes.
domain.wait: New DNS records can take from a few minutes to a few hours to work.
domain.attached: Domain connected. Its HTTPS certificate comes in about a minute.
domain.dnsOk: The domain points here and is verified
domain.httpsPending: Getting the HTTPS certificate, usually under a minute…
domain.httpsFailed: Couldn't get the HTTPS certificate yet. Check the CNAME or A record still points here; it's tried again in an hour.
domain.retryFailed: Couldn't send the request, please try again
domain.removeConfirm: Remove {domain} from the website? Visitors opening it won't see the website anymore.
domain.pointCname: For www.… or another subdomain: a CNAME record
domain.pointApex: For the root domain (without www, e.g. khachsan.vn): A records
domain.pointA: A records (for www.… and the root domain alike)
domain.cnameLater: CNAME records can't be used yet: use the A records.
domain.pointOnlyOne: Keep one way per name: remove that name's other A, AAAA or CNAME records.
domain.httpsSlow: The HTTPS certificate is taking longer than usual: requested at {when} and not here yet.
domain.httpsSlowCheck: Check that the CNAME or A record still points here as when you connected and that the domain has no other AAAA (IPv6) record, then press Try now. If it still doesn't come, contact Digistay support.

noAccess: Only the owner, admins and managers can edit the hotel website.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save keeps a version (one person's saves within 2 minutes are merged into one). The latest {limit} are kept.
versions.hint: Restoring brings the blocks, colors, fonts and SEO back to that version. Whether the site is published and its domain stay as they are.
versions.empty: No versions yet. The first one is made when you save your changes.
versions.viewLabel: View the {time} version in a new tab
versions.confirmBody: The live site goes back to this version as soon as you confirm. The current one is kept as a version, so you can go back to it.
versions.confirmUnsaved: Unsaved changes in the builder will be lost.
